appName.description: Extension name (manifest, toolbar title, page headers). Japanese: 推しライブアラート.

appDescription.message: Alerts you to new live and concert listings for your artists on e+, ローチケ, ぴあ, 楽天チケット, LivePocket, ASOBI TICKET, ZAN-LIVE, and ZAIKO.
appDescription.description: Manifest and Web Store short description, at most 132 characters. Keep the site names as they are.

pageTitleInbox.description: Browser tab title of the inbox page.

pageTitleSettings.description: Browser tab title of the settings page.

htmlLang.description: Language code of this catalog for <html lang> (not shown; Japanese: ja). It makes the browser pick the right font.

checkNow.description: Button and tooltip: ask every ticket site now instead of waiting for the next scheduled check.

openInbox.description: Toolbar popup button tooltip: opens the inbox page.

settings.description: Button tooltip and the settings page heading.

markAllRead.description: Button: mark every notification as read.

markUnread.description: Button tooltip in the notification detail.

star.description: Button tooltip: star a notification; starred ones are never cleared or deleted automatically.

delete.description: Button: delete a notification (also the confirm button of the clear dialog).

cancel.description: Button: close a dialog or stop renaming an artist without saving.

addArtists.description: Button in the empty popup, and the label of the add-artists field in Settings.

backToInbox.description: Tooltip of the back arrow on the settings page.

backToList.description: Tooltip of the back arrow in the notification detail (narrow windows).

notifications.description: Accessible name of the notification list, and the Settings section heading for notification switches.

unreadBadge.description: Accessible name of the dot shown on an unread notification.

openOnSite.description: Tooltip of a site chip on a notification; opens the listing on that ticket site.

checking.description: Shown while the sites are being asked and nothing has arrived yet.

checkingLeft.description: Status while a check runs: how many requests are still queued.

lastCheck.description: Status: when the last check ran. WHEN is a relative time (agoMinutes, …) or neverChecked.

neverChecked.description: Fills WHEN in lastCheck before the first check.

notCheckedYet.description: Settings, Check now row: no check has run yet.

artistCountOther.description: Status: number of artists watched (zero or several).

checkInterval.description: Inbox status: how often the sites are checked. INTERVAL is intervalMinutes or intervalHours.

statusSeparator.description: Joins parts of a status line, e.g. "Last check: 3 min ago · 4 artists".

dateTba.description: A listing whose date is not announced yet.

datesCount.description: After a date range: how many performance dates the live has (always 3 or more).

agoDays.description: Relative time in days (older ones show the date).

unreadCount.description: Popup header: number of unread notifications (1 or more).

allRead.description: Popup header when nothing is unread.

noArtists.description: Popup and Settings when no artist has been added.

noLiveInfo.description: Popup when artists are set but nothing has been found.

searchNotifications.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the inbox search field.

filter.description: Accessible name of the filter chips (All, Unread, Starred).

filterAll.description: Filter chip with the number of notifications.

filterUnread.description: Filter chip with the number of unread notifications.

filterStarred.description: Filter chip with the number of starred notifications.

clearRead.description: Inbox toolbar tooltip: delete every read notification that is not starred.

clearDialogTitle.description: Title of the confirm dialog for clearRead.

clearDialogTextOne.message: 1 read notification will be deleted. Starred ones stay.

clearDialogTextOther.message: $COUNT$ read notifications will be deleted. Starred ones stay.

emptyStart.message: Add artists in Settings to start.
emptyStart.description: Inbox list when no artist has been added.

emptyStarred.description: Inbox list, Starred filter, nothing starred.

emptyUnread.description: Inbox list, Unread filter, nothing unread.

emptyAll.description: Inbox list with no notifications (or none matching the search).

detailDeleted.description: Detail pane when the opened notification no longer exists.

detailSelect.description: Detail pane before a notification is chosen.

showFor.description: Tooltip of an artist name in the detail: searches the inbox for that artist.

posterMissing.description: Accessible name of the placeholder shown when the poster image cannot load.

venueTba.description: Detail: the venue is not announced yet.

foundAt.description: Detail: when the live was first found. WHEN is a local date and time.

updatedAt.description: Detail: when the live last changed. WHEN is a local date and time.

tickets.description: Detail section heading: the ticket listings (sales) found for this live.

openListing.description: Button on a ticket listing: opens it on the ticket site.

searchArtistOn.description: Detail section heading above one search link per ticket site.

updateNewSale.description: Note on a known live that got a new sale. SALE is the site’s own sale name (often Japanese, e.g. 一般発売).

updateAlsoOn.description: Note on a known live that appeared on another ticket site.

notifyNewLive.description: Notification title for one new live.

notifyUpdate.description: Notification title for an update. UPDATE is updateNewSale or updateAlsoOn.

notifyNewLives.description: Notification title when more than three new lives arrive at once.

notifyWatching.description: Notification title after artists are added: what is already listed for them.

notifyWatchingNote.message: Already on sale; you will be notified about new ones.

addArtistsPlaceholder.description: Example in the empty add-artists field. Keep the artist name.

addArtistsHelp.message: One artist per line. Enter adds, Shift+Enter starts a new line. A listing matches when its title or performers contain the name (width, case, and kana are ignored).
addArtistsHelp.description: Help under the add-artists field. "Width" means full-width vs half-width characters; "kana" means hiragana vs katakana.

addedArtists.description: After adding artists. NAMES is a comma-separated list.

alreadyListed.description: After adding artists that were already there. NAMES is a comma-separated list.

editArtist.description: Tooltip: rename an artist (also the rename field’s accessible name).

sectionChecking.description: Settings section heading: how and when the sites are checked.

checkEvery.description: Settings row: the check interval (a menu of intervalMinutes/intervalHours).

checkEveryHelp.message: How often every site is asked

sectionSites.description: Settings section heading: one switch per ticket site.

siteNotChecked.description: Site row before its first check. HOST is the site’s domain.

siteOk.description: Site row: the last check worked. WHEN is a relative time; the site’s domain follows as a link.

siteRetryIn.description: Site row after an error: the site is paused this many minutes.

siteBlockedHint.message: $LINK$ to pass its check, then Check now.
siteBlockedHint.description: Site row after a bot check. LINK is siteBlockedLink, a link to the site; keep it where the sentence needs it.

siteTermsWarning.message: This site’s terms forbid automated access. Turn on at your own risk
siteTermsWarning.description: Warning on an opt-in site (ZAN-LIVE, ZAIKO); a link to its terms follows.

siteTermsLink.description: Link to the site’s terms of use (利用規約) after siteTermsWarning.

tabFallback.message: Get past bot checks in a background tab

tabFallbackHelp.message: When a site shows a bot check, load it once in an inactive tab (opens and closes a tab briefly)

errorHttp.description: Site error: the site answered with this HTTP status.

errorChallenge.description: Site error: the site answered with a bot challenge.

errorChallengePage.description: Site error: the site returned a bot-check or queue page. DETAIL is a technical hint.

errorNotResults.message: not a results page (bot check or site change)
errorNotResults.description: Site error: the page did not look like search results.

errorNetwork.description: Site error: the request failed. DETAIL is the browser’s error text.

errorParse.description: Site error: the page could not be read. DETAIL is a technical error text.

notifyNewLivesSetting.description: Settings switch: a desktop notification for each new live.

notifyNewLivesHelp.message: A notification for each new live

notifyUpdatesSetting.description: Settings switch: notifications for updates too.

notifyUpdatesHelp.message: Also when a known live appears on another site or gets a new sale

illustrations.description: Settings row: the picture in the page corner (Default, Hidden, Your image).

illustrationsHelp.message: The picture in the corner of each page

decorCustom.description: Illustrations choice and row title: a picture the user uploads.

decorHint.message: Stays on this computer · PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF (animated up to 1 MB)

decorShrunk.message: Over 1 MB: stored at $SIZE$ px, with no animation
decorShrunk.description: After uploading a large picture: it was made smaller and still.

decorError.message: Could not read that image; try another file
decorError.description: After uploading a file that is not a readable picture.

creditsIllustrations.message: Illustrations: unofficial fan-made work of 魔法少女ノ魔女裁判 (AI利用). Not affiliated with Acacia or Re,AER.
creditsIllustrations.description: Settings footer credit. Keep the work title, (AI利用), and the company names as they are.
